title: E4: scorecard shows tool-call waste per task and goal from jev-gate.jsonl, plus turns per run
spec:
Make the token diet measurable. Build on E3 (T-0215, .orchestrator/runs/jev-gate.jsonl rows {task, tool, p_needed, p_redundant, blocked}), E7 (T-0212, run records carry turns) and P6 (T-0207) in orchestrator/scorecard.py:
1. by_task() and by_goal() gain columns calls (scored tool calls), waste_pct (share of calls with p_needed < 0.3 or p_redundant > 0.7), blocked, and turns (sum of run turns for the task / goal). Missing jev-gate.jsonl or runs without turns render '-' and never raise.
2. Footer line 'jev: N calls scored, M USD' from .orchestrator/runs/jev-*.jsonl input_tokens at 0.042 USD per M tokens (constant JEV_USD_PER_M in scorecard.py).
3. Default `orchestrator scorecard` output stays byte-identical; the new columns appear only with --by task|goal.
Tests in tests/test_scorecard.py with fixture jsonl files: waste percent, blocked count, turns sum, missing file renders '-', footer cost.
